qualification_boundaries: Completed R56 full frozen source plus exactly five owned R57 snippets in four production files. Fresh runtime, host, main TUs and link, compiler/runtime/provider hashes and before/after source identities close the actual product. Other concurrent workspace edits are not qualified by this frozen cut.

The copied-local query and canonical object reader share the existing C-family type spelling policy from actual CU language. TinyGo/Zig producer flags override C metadata; Rust and unknown CU language retain original names. No language or width is guessed from a name.

C-family const/volatile modifiers and named typedef aliases are formatted by the existing bounded fast_io declarator formatter. Generated prefix bytes consume the remaining shared result-string budget. Malformed metadata or budget overflow publishes no partial list.

Type display grants no storage authority. Unavailable captures and original missing locations remain unavailable. Native carrier bits, source scalar classification and existing stop/cohort/frame authentication are preserved.

Six original source parameters are checked in Source variables plus three evaluate contexts both before and after one actual Wasm instruction. Queued old frame/scope/expression requests are rejected, fresh frames reacquire the same values and qualified types; every guest self-check and original OS wait/broker wait/DAP EOF is zero.

Four C-family compiler frontends, Wasm32/64, DWARF4/5, O0/O1 and instruction/unwind policies are finite original-producer coverage, with original validator and DWARF verifier results. No producer Wasm/DWARF rewrite.

Sixteen actual target ELF DATA executions per repository test the changed copied scalar formatter, qualifiers, alias, native integer/IEEE carriers, shared string budget, malformed input, language gates and unavailable capture. ELF machine, bits and byte order, dependency/provider before-after hashes, and stdout equality to actual pinned native x86_64 are verified. This does not qualify full target VM/JIT/DAP.

Module import declaration is synchronized, but no C++ module BMI build is counted. No full native IDE parity, every language ABI, standard Go/AssemblyScript completeness, RTTI/collections, dynamic Objective-C runtime formatting, assignment/watchpoints/guest calls or all optimized DWARF locations is claimed.
